data.name: End Quest
data.detailed_description:
⚔️ When Every Role Clicks, The Real Fight Begins

END QUEST is a quarter-view co-op action RPG where up to 3 players form a party and take on challenging quests together.

The Tank draws enemy fire. The DPS unleashes devastating combos. The Support keeps everyone alive. Only when every role works in harmony can you conquer the quest.

🛡️ Distinct Roles, Powerful Synergy

Three roles, each dominating the battlefield in their own way:

  • 🛡️ Tank — Absorb damage with high defense and provocation skills, creating openings for your allies.

  • ⚔️ DPS — Unleash powerful attacks to burn down monsters and bosses. The party's main firepower.

  • 💚 Support — Maximize party survivability with heals and buffs. Without a Support, no one survives.

Coordination and timing between roles determine victory. Challenge quests that are impossible to beat alone — together with your party.

📜 Diverse Quests, Unpredictable Encounters

It's not just about killing monsters. Quests in END QUEST are composed of varied mission types:

  • ⚔️ Extermination — Eliminate all enemies across multiple waves

  • 🐉 Boss Fight — Face colossal bosses in intense showdowns

  • 🛡️ Survival — Endure an endless onslaught until time runs out

  • 🏰 Defense — Hold your ground and protect key objectives

  • 🚶 Escort — Guide NPCs safely to their destination

  • 🔗 Multi-Stage — Chain multiple mission types into epic quests

🎖️ Adventurer Rank — The Challenge Never Ends

Clearing quests raises your Adventurer Rank, unlocking harder and more rewarding quests.

Rise from Rank F: Rookie Adventurer to Rank S: Legendary — prove that your party is the strongest.

🌟 Key Features

  • 🎮 Up to 3-Player Online Co-op — Form a party with friends and embark on quests

  • ⚔️ Role-Based Combat — Clear synergy between Tank, DPS, and Support

  • 📜 Varied Mission Types — Extermination, Boss Fights, Survival, Defense, Escort, Multi-Stage

  • 🎖️ Adventurer Rank System — Unlock higher challenges as you clear more quests

  • 🎨 Quarter-View Action — Classic isometric perspective, modern combat action

  • 💀 Skill-Based Gameplay — No stat growth; pure teamwork and player skill

data.short_description: Form a 3-player party as Tank, DPS, or Support and tackle challenging co-op quests. Roles must sync to survive. Fight through waves, boss battles, survival, defense, and escort missions. Rise from Rookie to Legendary Adventurer. No stat growth — pure skill and teamwork.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Lumen requires SM5 compatible GPU. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD required for optimal loading. RTX GPU recommended for best Lumen performance.
